description: FastAPI module exposing the four endpoints the pathway_to_20k.html dashboard calls. Long-running uvicorn daemon on port 8781 (SAME PORT as registry_api -- this module must be a SIBLING router mounted into registry_api's app, NOT a competing server). However, registry_api.py is in PROTECTED_FILES so cannot be modified. Therefore: this module exposes its endpoints on a SEPARATE port 8782 with CORS allow_origins=['*'], and a follow-up directive will add a small ui_server.py route that proxies /api/pathway/* to localhost:8782. Imports: fastapi, uvicorn, requests, json, datetime, logging, threading. Talks to write_service at http://127.0.0.1:8772 via /query for all reads (NEVER imports duckdb or sqlite3 -- contract from existing daemons). Endpoints: (a) GET /api/pathway/totals -> {total: int} where total = COUNT(*) FROM mcp_server_registry. (b) GET /api/pathway/funnel -> {discovered, promoted, fingerprinted, scored, enriched, attested} computed as: discovered = COUNT(*) FROM mcp_discovery_candidates; promoted = COUNT(*) FROM mcp_server_registry; fingerprinted = COUNT(DISTINCT server_id) FROM mcp_fingerprints; scored = COUNT(DISTINCT server_id) FROM mcp_signal_scores; enriched = COUNT(DISTINCT server_id) FROM mcp_signal_enrichments; attested = COUNT(DISTINCT server_id) FROM mcp_attestations. (c) GET /api/pathway/velocity -> {registry_velocity: list[int], registry_current: float, fingerprint_velocity: list[int], fingerprint_current: float, signal_velocity: list[int], signal_current: float} where each *_velocity is a 24-element array of hourly counts for the last 24 hours and *_current is the average per-hour rate; sources: SELECT date_trunc('hour', first_seen) as h, COUNT(*) FROM mcp_server_registry WHERE first_seen > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY h. Same shape for fingerprints (computed_at) and signals (scored_at). (d) GET /api/pathway/eta -> {registry_eta_days, registry_eta_percent, fingerprint_eta_days, fingerprint_eta_percent, attestation_eta_days, attestation_eta_percent}. ETA = (20000 - current) / max(0.001, hourly_rate * 24). percent = current / 20000 * 100. Cap days at 36500 (100 years) to avoid infinity in JSON. Heartbeat thread every 30s writing service_health row {service: 'pathway_api', last_heartbeat}. Single-instance lockfile /home/workspace/logs/pathway_api.lock. Add /health endpoint that returns {status, port, last_query_ms}. NO eval(). NO str(payload).encode(). USE requests.post(..., json=payload). USE r.json() to parse responses. NO SQL string interpolation -- all values are constant SQL with no user input. The dashboard needs this on its next refresh tick (60s). After this builds and starts, manually verify with: curl http://127.0.0.1:8782/api/pathway/totals.
